2024 Annual Report, note on expenses by nature (research and development)
source.quote: During the year ended 31 December 2024, the Group had incurred expenses for the purpose of research and development of approximately RMB70,686 million (2023: RMB64,078 million)

notes: Taxes: 'Income tax paid' in operating cash flows (net line as presented). R&D: Tencent's income statement has no separate R&D line; the expenses-by-nature note discloses R&D expenses incurred of RMB70,686 million and says no significant development expenses were capitalised.
